parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The internal name used to identify the SFP Cage instance.

parameters.name: SFPPresent
parameters.description: The value {{true}} indicates the presence of a SFP in the SFP Cage instance. The value is always {{true}} for a SFF. Note: A value of 0x02 in {{param|SFF8024Identifier}} will also indicate the presence of an SFF.

parameters.name: SFF8024Identifier
parameters.description: Ths identifier describes the type of SFP and the management protocol as per "Identifier Value" listed in {{bibref|SFF-8024|Table 4-1}}.

parameters.name: MgmtInterface
parameters.description: This parameter indicates the management interface used by the SFP. Refer {{bibref|SFF-8024|Table 4-1}} and {{bibref|SFF-8472}}.

parameters.name: SFPType
parameters.description: This value is applicable only when {{param|SFPPresent}} is {{true}}. The SFP Type is classified as one of: GPON, XGS-PON, Optical Ethernet, Copper Ethernet. If the SFP Type cannot be classified, the value is reported as "Unsupported".

parameters.name: SFPReference
parameters.description: The path to the SFP management object associated with this interface.

object.description: This object describes a cage into which an SFP is inserted. This object can also describe an instance of Small Form Factor (SFF) units soldered on to the platform.
